newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: HORSE RACING-Curragh racecourse gains sponsors via the Internet.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-Curragh racecourse gains sponsors via the Internet.

text.p: The Curragh racecourse in County Kildare has signed a sponsorship deal with the oldest trading Irish pub and hotel in Sydney, Australia, over the Internet, Ireland's Turf Club said in a statement on Wednesday.
The statement said "The Mercantile Pub Maiden" would be run at The Curragh on Irish Oaks Day, July 13, 1997.
The Curragh's Web Site had attracted the attention of the owners of The Mercantile pub and hotel, the statement said.
